title: Run the exhaust fan on after the heater
brief: The heater is on while the Heater switch is On. The exhaust fan runs while the heater is on, and keeps running for 5 s after the heater turns off, to clear the fumes. Each press of Purge also runs the fan for exactly 3 s, however long the button is held.
hints: The fan must keep running after the heater turns off: which timer keeps its Q on for PT after IN goes off?
Each Purge press should give a run of a fixed length, whatever the button does: which timer makes a pulse?
The fan runs if either timer's Q is on: two contacts in parallel before the Fan coil.

scenarios.name: The fan runs on 5 s after the heater

assertions.says: The heater should be on while the Heater switch is On.
The fan should run while the heater is on.
The heater should turn off with its switch.
The fan should keep running for 5 s after the heater turns off.
The fan should stop 5 s after the heater turns off.

windows.says: The fan should stop 5 s after the heater turns off (at 7.0 s).

scenarios.name: Purge runs the fan for 3 s

assertions.says: After a Purge press the fan should run for 3 s, not only while the button is held.
Purge must not turn the heater on.
The purge should end 3 s after the press.

windows.says: The fan should stop 3 s after the Purge press (at 3.5 s).

assertions.says: The fan should run during the purge.
The purge should end 3 s after the press, even with the button still held.

scenarios.name: Heater off and on again keeps the fan running

assertions.says: The fan should run on after the heater.
The fan should run while the heater is on again.
The 5 s run-on should start again from the last time the heater turned off.
The fan should stop 5 s after the heater's last turn off.
